validation: First fold of shuffled 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold, stratified by attack category; identical 42-feature records grouped together
selection_metric: validation macro F1; ties broken by lower false positive rate, then candidate name
test_policy: Lock all candidate settings, winner and thresholds using training/validation only. Refit each family winner on complete training partition. Evaluate each frozen model once on the complete separate 82332-row test partition. Also report test records with no exact feature match in training, and a unique feature-plus-answer version of that subset. Do not retune after test scores.
duplicate_policy: Preserve original record frequencies; group identical feature vectors for validation; report duplicates and conflicting labels; do not silently repair labels or remove difficult test records.
bootstrap: 400 Poisson bootstrap replications by exact-feature group on official test data; descriptive 95% intervals conditional on this benchmark
extensions: Multiclass attack categorization is a separately reported extension; binary detection remains the main deliverable.
application: No GUI or web application in scope. Provide command-line prediction for saved-model verification.
